properties.description: Every presented data beat matches the accepted-input prefix, including zero padding, truncation, order and final-byte marking; comparisons do not require ready.
Every presented status matches the next completed accepted input frame, independently of data-channel progress.
Blocked data and status responses retain validity and payload until acceptance or reset.
Synchronous reset clears both response valids and cancels all queued epoch obligations without clearing historical failures.
Checks source hold behavior, reset-time source validity, bounded frame lengths and meaningful control/payload observations; unknowns cannot establish success.
Combinational final-marker completion checks require no outstanding accepted frame, data, status or presented valid, with a sufficient quiet drain tail; bounded-storage exhaustion remains unresolved.
